question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Exhaust
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e.** 'Restore'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is** 'Exhaust'** which means to drain of resources or properties; completely used up.(थका हुआ).

 
 
• **For example:** The long journey exhausted our supplies.
 
 
 
• The antonym or opposite of 'Exhaust' is** 'Restore'**, which means to bring back or re-establish a previous condition.(बहाल करना).
 
 
• **For example:** Efforts were made to restore the damaged building.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 4' i.e.** 'Restore'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png]
